description: ABAT variant spectrum in ClinVar, gnomAD constraint, and ancestry-stratified pLoF allele frequency
code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0","Content-Type":"application/json"})

# gnomAD v4 ABAT variants
q="""query { gene(gene_symbol:"ABAT", reference_genome:GRCh38){
 gnomad_constraint{oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper pLI mis_z lof_z}
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ variant_id hgvsc hgvsp consequence lof
   exome{ac an ac_hom populations{id ac an}} genome{ac an ac_hom} } } }"""
d=S.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",data=json.dumps({"query":q}),timeout=300).json()["data"]["gene"]
con=d["gnomad_constraint"]
rows=[]
POPS={}
for v in d["variants"]:
    e=v.get("exome") or {}; g=v.get("genome") or {}
    ac=(e.get("ac") or 0)+(g.get("ac") or 0); an=(e.get("an") or 0)+(g.get("an") or 0)
    rows.append(dict(csq=v["consequence"],lof=v.get("lof"),ac=ac,an=an,af=ac/an if an else 0,
                     hgvsp=v.get("hgvsp"),vid=v["variant_id"]))
    if v.get("lof")=="HC" and e.get("populations"):
        for p in e["populations"]:
            if "_" in p["id"]: continue
            a=POPS.setdefault(p["id"],[0,0]); a[0]+=p["ac"]; a[1]=max(a[1],p["an"])
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); plof=df[df.lof=="HC"]
qlof=plof.af.sum()
pop=pd.DataFrame([(k,v[0],v[1],v[0]/v[1]) for k,v in POPS.items() if v[1]>0],
                 columns=["pop","ac","an","af"]).sort_values("af",ascending=False)

# ClinVar P/LP consequence spectrum (ABAT-specific, excluding multi-gene CNVs)
base="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi"
def cnt(term):
    time.sleep(0.5)
    return int(S.get(base,params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmax":0,"retmode":"json"},timeout=90).json()["esearchresult"]["count"])
plp='ABAT[gene] AND ("clinsig pathogenic"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely pathogenic"[Properties])'
mcs={"missense":"missense variant","nonsense":"nonsense","frameshift":"frameshift variant",
     "splice donor":"splice donor variant","splice acceptor":"splice acceptor variant"}
cvc={k:cnt(f'{plp} AND "{v}"[molecular consequence]') for k,v in mcs.items()}
print("ClinVar P/LP consequences:",cvc)
print("constraint:",con, "| qLoF=%.3e"%qlof)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
# A: ClinVar P/LP spectrum
k=list(cvc); vals=[cvc[x] for x in k]
ax[0].bar(k,vals,color="#4C78A8")
ax[0].set_title("ABAT ClinVar pathogenic / likely pathogenic\nvariants by molecular consequence")
ax[0].set_ylabel("number of variants"); ax[0].tick_params(axis="x",rotation=30)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[0].text(i,v+0.2,str(v),ha="center")
ax[0].text(0.98,0.95,f"truncating {sum(vals)-cvc['missense']}/{sum(vals)}",transform=ax[0].transAxes,ha="right",va="top",fontsize=9)

# B: constraint
ax[1].barh(["pLI","LOEUF (oe_lof upper)","o/e LoF","missense z","LoF z"],
           [con["pLI"],con["oe_lof_upper"],con["oe_lof"],con["mis_z"],con["lof_z"]],color="#F58518")
ax[1].axvline(0.35,ls="--",c="grey"); ax[1].text(0.36,4.2,"LOEUF 0.35\nhaploinsufficiency cut-off",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax[1].set_title("gnomAD v4 constraint for ABAT:\nheterozygous LoF is tolerated")
ax[1].set_xlabel("value")

# C: per-ancestry pLoF allele frequency
pp=pop.head(9)
ax[2].bar(pp["pop"],pp["af"]*1e4,color="#54A24B")
ax[2].set_ylabel("pLoF allele frequency (per 10,000)")
ax[2].set_title("Summed high-confidence pLoF allele frequency\nby gnomAD v4 exome ancestry group")
ax[2].tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(pop.to_string())
print("\nCarrier freq from pLoF alone 2q = %.5f (1 in %.0f)"%(2*qlof,1/(2*qlof)))
print("Birth prevalence from pLoF alone q^2 = 1 in %.0f"%(1/qlof**2))
